NPKL.name: Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Layout (west)
NPKL.ask: Open-market resale here ~Rs 6,800-9,000/ft² (NoBroker Bheemanakuppe ~Rs 6,800; BDAsites NPKL 6th Block asks ~Rs 9,000). But past BDA auctions CLEARED much higher — 96 T-11 Bheemanakuppe finals at a median Rs 11,241/ft² (IQR 9,441-13,146), i.e. winners paid an auction premium over resale. So resale value is set to the open market (~Rs 8,000) while the expected winning bid follows the auction comps. Provisional.
NPKL.story: BDA's large new layout on the western fringe — Kommaghatta, Bheemanakuppe, Sulikere, Kannalli, Kodigehalli and nearby villages off Mysore Road and the NICE Road, near Kengeri. Formed in the 2020s and still developing: trunk roads and services are going in, titles are clean, and prices are appreciating fast on a low base, but amenities and resale depth lag the established South/West layouts. Market figures here are provisional until NPKL's own sales give firmer comps.
drivers: Mysore Road + Kengeri (Purple Line metro terminus / Challaghatta depot)
NICE Road access to ORR and the south
Large contiguous BDA layout with clean titles
watch: Far west — village-level amenities still maturing
Thin resale history, so price discovery is early
Infrastructure and lake-buffer timelines vary by block
Provisional market model — not yet re-based on NPKL sales

projects.name: Purple Line to Challaghatta (Kengeri terminus)
projects.effect: Kengeri / Challaghatta metro gives the west a direct run to Majestic and the central IT corridor; feeder buses from the layout.

projects.name: Mysore Road + NICE Road access
projects.effect: Quick reach to ORR-south, Electronic City and the airport expressway via NICE Road, and into the city on Mysore Rd.

projects.name: Kengeri ORR-Ullal grade separator
projects.effect: Signal-free approach from Ullal to Mysore Rd, cutting the west-side commute.

projects.name: Relaxed setbacks for plots up to 1,500 ft²
projects.effect: Small plots get more buildable area, which helps the many small lots in this auction.

projects.name: GBA takes over BDA layout maintenance
projects.effect: Pending roads, drains and streetlights now funded 50:50 by BDA and the city corporation; should speed up civic works.

projects.name: Brand-new layout — trunk infrastructure still going in
projects.effect: Roads, underground drainage, piped water and streetlights are incomplete in parts; expect tankers and unpaved stretches early. Check the specific block on site.

projects.name: Far west, village-interface pockets
projects.effect: Several sectors abut villages and farmland; verify approach-road width, encroachment, and that the survey number is in the final BDA plan.

calibration.note: Likely winning bids come from a model trained on real final bids from BDA auctions T-08 and T-11 (bdaeauction.in archive).
